ValidationRule.description: When the "Infrastructure-License Key Purpose" is set to Tanium as a Service, make the "Server Hostnames" not required. It's redundant since they will be completing the Vanity field. This rule replaced-Server_Hostnames_and_Country_Validation -[INC0140238]
ValidationRule.errorConditionFormula: AND( ISBLANK( Country__c ), NOT( RecordType.DeveloperName = "TaaS" ), NOT($Permission.DisableValidationRules))
ValidationRule.errorMessage: Country field required. please enter values for the Country field.
